extension.description: BEZEL 2.0 has no home screen: it starts in the BEZEL MUSIC LIST of recently played albums, the logo opens a slide-out section menu and every library uses the BEZEL list. Standard windows and dialogs are derived from Estuary by phil65 and Ichabod Fletchman (Team Kodi). Font: Ubuntu (Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0).
